advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add `detected_by` to `_IMMUTABLE_EDIT_FIELDS` (or otherwise enforce its immutability) so it can be trusted as the completion-bypass authorization key.
evidence: _processors.py:360 `_IMMUTABLE_EDIT_FIELDS = frozenset({"creation_channel", "creation_channel_inferred"})` — `detected_by` is absent
_processors.py:374-387 process_edit merges any field already present in state (except _IMMUTABLE_EDIT_FIELDS) via last-writer-wins `state[field_name] = new_value`
ADR 0117: 'allow the completion-verification bypass only when the ticket's immutable `detected_by` provenance is one of exactly ...' — the immutability premise is not enforced by the reducer
advisory.finding: ADR 0117 and the guard rely on `detected_by` being immutable creation provenance, but `detected_by` is NOT in `_IMMUTABLE_EDIT_FIELDS`, so an EDIT event can overwrite it once present in state. This lets a ticket's provenance be mutated after creation to acquire an allowlisted detector value used to unlock the env_integration bypass.
scenarios: A ticket created with a benign detected_by is edited to `heartbeat-canary` (if detected_by is present in state), then closed with `--class env_integration` to skip completion verification.

evidence: src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:541: `if not close_reason:` — the disposition path mandates a --reason
src/rebar/_commands/close_disposition.py:63: `REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES = frozenset({"obsolete", "wontfix", "not_a_bug", "escalated"})` — env_integration is not a member

src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:338: `admits_close_reason = force is None and (close_class in close_disposition.REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES)` — env_integration discards the free-text reason at write time
docs/adr/0117-bot-alert-disposition.md:48: 'The close event records a bounded class and the recovery reason' — contradicted by the write path
blocking.finding: The bot-alert env_integration close requires and signs a --reason, but that reason is NOT persisted on the close STATUS event: env_integration is absent from close_disposition.REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES, so both txn._stamp_close_metadata and _lib_writes discard close_reason for it. ADR 0117 states the close event 'records ... the recovery reason', which does not hold on the durable event.
scenarios: A canary lane closes a recovered alert with --class env_integration --reason 'Fixed: reconciler recovered at <ts>'; the STATUS event records close_class=env_integration but no close_reason, so the durable audit trail loses the recovery justification.

blocking.checklist_item: - [ ] Verify that `detected_by` cannot be set to an allowlisted canary value by arbitrary creators/actors before it is trusted as the sole key for the env_integration completion bypass.
evidence: close_precheck.py:534 `if detected_by not in _BOT_ALERT_DETECTORS:` — the bypass key is `detected_by`
composer.py:235-239 sets `data["detected_by"]` from `resolve_detected_by(detected_by)` with only strip+lowercase, no value authorization
_config_resolvers.py:315-320 `resolve_detected_by` returns the explicit param or `REBAR_DETECTED_BY` env var verbatim
_cli/_parsers/core/writes.py:44 `parser.add_argument("--detected-by", help="detected_by:<gate> tag (bugs)")` — freely settable to any string by any creator
ADR 0117 asserts the guard relies on 'immutable detected_by provenance', but nothing restricts who may assert an allowlisted detector value at CREATE
blocking.finding: The `_bot_alert_disposition` completion-verification bypass authorizes solely on `detected_by`, which is client-supplied at CREATE via the freely-settable `--detected-by` CLI flag / `REBAR_DETECTED_BY` env var with no server-side restriction on its value. Any actor able to create a bug can set `detected_by=heartbeat-canary` (or another allowlisted detector) and then close it with `--class env_integration`, skipping the completion verifier the guard is meant to protect.
scenarios: A non-canary actor creates a bug with `--detected-by=heartbeat-canary`, then closes it with `--class env_integration --reason=...` and bypasses completion verification on a ticket with real acceptance criteria.
